description: A non-exclusive map of solving and diagnostic families. Page existence is not evidence of a completed experiment; related records cover only their stated variants.

families.title: Fixed alphabet substitutions
families.description: Replace each rune consistently with one other symbol.

families.title: Homophonic and many-to-one substitutions
families.description: Allow several ciphertext symbols to represent the same plaintext symbol.

families.title: Repeating-key and polyalphabetic ciphers
families.description: Change the substitution according to position in a repeated key.

families.title: Fractionation and coordinate alphabets
families.description: Split symbols into coordinates, rearrange the components, then regroup.

families.title: Block and matrix transformations
families.description: Transform groups of runes together instead of treating each position independently.

families.title: Arithmetic keystreams
families.description: Generate shifts from a declared numerical sequence.

families.title: Autokey and ciphertext feedback
families.description: Use earlier plaintext or ciphertext to update later decoding state.

families.title: Seeded generators and unrestricted additive keys
families.description: Distinguish short reproducible generators from unrestricted per-position keys.

families.title: Running keys from external texts
families.description: Convert a specified external text into a stream of key symbols.

families.title: Nulls, interruptions and reset rules
families.description: Specify which symbols consume output or key state and when state restarts.

families.title: Offsets and key alignment
families.description: Search starting positions and a bounded set of alignment changes.

families.title: Transposition and permutations
families.description: Change symbol order while preserving the selected symbols.

families.title: Grid layouts, spirals and route ciphers
families.description: Choose an explicit layout and traversal through its cells.

families.title: Grilles and positional extraction
families.description: Select positions using a mask or indexing rule.

families.title: Acrostics and boundary-letter extraction
families.description: Select initial, final or regularly indexed symbols from defined units.

families.title: Word, row, page and section boundaries
families.description: Treat boundary choices as explicit input or reset variants.

families.title: Book ciphers and coordinate lookups
families.description: Select symbols from a specified source text using explicit coordinate and counting rules.

families.title: Gematria and rune-sum mappings
families.description: Map runes or groups to numerical totals and count competing matches.

families.title: Prime indexing and value transforms
families.description: Distinguish rune indices, prime values and prime indices before composing operations.

families.title: Bounded arithmetic expressions
families.description: Declare a finite grammar of operations rather than searching unlimited expressions.

families.title: Radix changes and byte encodings
families.description: Specify how symbols become digits, integers and bytes.

families.title: Bitwise combinations and XOR
families.description: Operate on explicitly encoded bits or bytes, with alignment and key rules.

families.title: Magic squares and numerical grids
families.description: Separate reconstructing a grid from using it as a decoding key.

families.title: File steganography and embedded payloads
families.description: Recover data using a specified carrier format, extraction tool and key.

families.title: Image transforms and overlays
families.description: Measure features under declared processing and alignment choices.

families.title: Geometric constructions and navigation
families.description: Turn measured positions into reproducible construction and traversal rules.

families.title: Audio and frequency encodings
families.description: Separate signal processing measurements from a proposed symbol encoding.

families.title: Layered decoding and file chains
families.description: Specify the order of transformations and verify each intermediate artifact.

families.title: Public-key messages and cryptographic artifacts
families.description: Work from explicit parameters and historical artifacts rather than assuming the rune text uses the same mechanism.

families.title: Hash targets and candidate retrieval
families.description: Define exact candidate bytes and compare the specified digest.

families.title: Language and corpus identification
families.description: Compare declared observables with suitable language controls under explicit cipher assumptions.

families.title: Known plaintext and crib searches
families.description: Use a declared plaintext hypothesis to constrain a defined cipher model.

families.title: Automatic search and language scoring
families.description: Explore a bounded model with a scorer whose ability and false positives have been checked.

families.title: Alternative alphabets and symbolic notations
families.description: Define a symbol inventory and an encoding rule before interpreting resemblance.

families.title: Literary references and thematic clues
families.description: Establish a source relationship, then distinguish interpretation from an executable decoding rule.

families.title: AI-assisted candidate interpretation
families.description: Treat generated readings as proposals requiring independent, reproducible checks.

families.title: Period and key-length diagnostics
families.description: Measure position-dependent patterns with matched null models and correction for searched periods.

families.title: Repeats, doublets and word structure
families.description: Test structural constraints without automatically converting them into a cipher identification.

families.title: Invariants and bounded exclusions
families.description: State the assumptions under which an operation preserves or forbids an observed property.

families.title: Null models and selection effects
families.description: Repeat the whole selection procedure on controls, not just the final attractive candidate.

families.title: Source verification and transcription audits
families.description: Verify the input and the scope of its authenticity or transcription evidence.

families.title: Codebooks and mixed letter-word systems
families.description: Map defined groups to words, syllables or phrases under a consistent dictionary.

families.title: Differential and cumulative decoding
families.description: Transform changes between values with declared direction, lag, modulus and initial conditions.

families.title: Compression and packed symbol streams
families.description: Specify both the conversion into bytes and the format used to decode those bytes.

families.title: Page and section ordering
families.description: Reorder whole pages or sections while accounting for the arrangements searched.
